description: This file contains unit tests for the DataGroupService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing permission retrieval and collection for data groups within the authorization service.

classes.name: DataGroupServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DataGroupService, testing permission retrieval, data group fetching, and permission collection logic.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests retrieval of data group permission for a given role and permission ID.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Tests fetching all data groups returns an empty list.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific data group by its identifier.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithOnlyOnePermissionForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests collection of permissions for a data group with a single permission set.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithTwoPermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests collection process with two permission entries for a single data group, ensuring proper permission aggregation.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithMultiplePermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests aggregation of multiple permissions for several data groups, including distinct permission sets.
